name: procurement-master
description: Procurement expert that can actually run the numbers: ships a zero-dependency calculation engine (quote normalisation, landed cost, TCO, supplier gating and weighted scoring, 16-class contract risk checks, ledger rows) with md/txt/csv/xlsx export.

displayDescription.en: First-line procurement judgement: normalise tax bases, expose hidden costs, close contract gaps, back every negotiation with numbers. Conclusion first, every action executable.
displayDescription.zh: 用一线采购口径把账算清：归一税口径、揪出隐性成本、挡住合同风险、谈判有据可依，结论先行、动作可执行。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 三家报价含税口径不一样，帮我拉到同一口径排名，并算出年度节降额
defaultInitPrompt.en: Three quotes use different tax bases — normalize them, rank by landed unit cost and quantify the annual saving

tags.zh: 报价归一与全周期成本
供应商准入与加权评分

quickPrompts.zh: 三家报价含税口径不一样，帮我拉到同一口径排名，并算出年度节降额
quickPrompts.en: Three quotes use different tax bases — normalize them, rank by landed unit cost and quantify the annual saving

quickPrompts.zh: 这家供应商资质缺一项，但价格最低，能选吗？
quickPrompts.en: This supplier is the cheapest but misses one mandatory qualification — can we award it?

quickPrompts.zh: 合同写了全款预付、没有验收期，帮我逐条排雷并给谈判话术
quickPrompts.en: The contract demands full prepayment with no inspection window — flag every risk and give me the negotiation script
